item.title: Afternoon Weather for Sunday, August 23
item.description: Good afternoon! Welcome to your weather report for Sunday, August 23. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be rumbling with thunderstorms. The warmest part of the day will be 31 degrees, and the coolest 27. There is a 99 percent chance of rain. Pack your umbrella and your wellies! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be damp with light drizzle, with a high of 32 degrees. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
